task: Stop /api/history from silently returning an empty array when path is omitted (#96)

events.summary: Scoped to the /api/history handler, a new /api/history/stats endpoint, the one dashboard caller that relied on the path-less call, and the two API tables in docs/web-ui*.md. internal/quota, internal/agent, the history store itself, CRDs, RBAC and chart privileges are untouched. Option 1 from #96 (split stats out, require path) was chosen over option 2 (keep path optional, make the empty response explicit) because the dashboard is the only path-less caller in the repo, so the cleaner contract costs no compatibility

Against the live e2e cluster, GET /api/history?period=24h with no path returned 200 with history: [] while the same response's stats.entries reported 194 stored entries; with path=/export/pvc-test1 the same window returned 96 entries. Root cause read from internal/history/store.go queryUnlocked, which requires e.Path == path exactly, so an empty path matches nothing. Since afb7150 the handler already rejected malformed start/end with 400, leaving a missing path as the one silently ignored input

handleAPIHistory returns 400 {error: path is required} right after the nil-store early return and before period/start/end parsing, so TestHandleAPIHistory_Disabled (no path, no store) keeps its enabled:false contract. New GET /api/history/stats behind the same authMiddleware returns {enabled:false} without a store or {enabled:true, stats} with one. The dashboard's Trends tab reads stats from the new endpoint; the path-scoped /api/history response is otherwise unchanged and still carries stats. Both docs tables gain the new row and note that path is required

Test-first: TestHandleAPIHistory_MissingPath and TestHandleAPIHistoryStats_Disabled/_Enabled were written before the handler existed and failed to compile (handleAPIHistoryStats undefined), then passed after the change. TestHandleAPIHistory_InvalidRange rows gained an explicit path so they keep exercising start/end validation rather than tripping the new path gate first; a separate read-only review lane confirmed no case was weakened, that both routes are registered as exact Go 1.22 mux patterns like /api/orphans and /api/orphans/scan, that no unauthenticated-path allowlist exists that would need the new route, and that the only remaining /api/history caller in the repo always sends a path
events.scope: handler ordering, route registration, auth wrapping and the new/changed tests in internal/ui, through httptest against an in-memory history.Store

events.summary: Built the tree as nfs-quota-agent:ui-preview7 on the colima docker daemon and rolled it onto the nqa-e2e DaemonSet (pullPolicy Never). Against the live agent: /api/history with no path, with and without period, returned 400 {error: path is required}; /api/history/stats returned 200 with enabled:true and 222 entries across 2 paths, so the history file survived the rollout; /api/history?path=/export/pvc-test1&period=24h returned 200 with 111 entries and stats still present. In headless Chromium the Trends tab's three stats cards showed 222 / 2 / 720h0m0s from the new endpoint, the chart rendered and no error banner appeared
